claims.claim: Mandatory pension: employee 6.0% / 6%, employer 6.5% (of which about 0.5% disability insurance), plus a severance component. Severance (pitzuim) equals one month per year of service, about 8.33%. Section 14 (סעיף 14, Section 14) lets pension contributions count toward severance. Tech sector commonly offers 7% / 7.5% / 8%.

claims.claim: Convalescence pay (dmei havra'a) 2026 private-sector rate NIS 418 / 418 ש"ח per day (frozen from 2024-2025), public-sector about NIS 471.4 / 471.4 ש"ח per day. claims.claim: Under section 10(a)(1) of the Equal Employment Opportunities Law the Labour Court may award damages without pecuniary loss in an amount it sees fit, with no ceiling for an ordinary section 2 discrimination claim. The 120,000 NIS cap applies only to a civil claim for a section 7 infringement.
